clock.note: Scene order is the cut order. Each kept segment is (gi, start, dur) inside the scene recording drive/voice/<id>.m4a, numbered exactly as drive/voice-manifest.json; `at` is its place on the cut clock. Segments are laid end to end with 0.45 s between them inside a scene and 1.2 s at each scene seam (split before/after); bridges are bed-only. The bed under a scene is its book's track (trackFor(book) as in harness/build-film-audio.mjs).
